title: Wick Liquor Ardour 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Wick Liquor Ardour is a deep and velvety fruit blend. It combines the rich, slightly tart taste of braised blackcurrant with a medley of dark forest berries and a smooth raspberry puree. This layered profile is bold, juicy, and packed with authentic berry character. Manufactured in Staffordshire, Wick Liquor is a premium boutique brand famous for its "big block" approach to flavour, offering some of the most distinct and high-quality blends on the market. This Nic Salt version offers the same legendary taste in a smooth format. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with low-wattage pod kits and starter vape kits, producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Wick Liquor Nic Salts are available in 10mg and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
